name: docker-compose PostgreSQL 16 → 18 (app-repo half of Phase 19; the RDS half, 19b, is a separate PR in core-iac)
deployed: not deployable on its own: docker-compose.yml only drives local dev and the CI database; the production image and Helm chart are untouched

changes.docker_compose_db_image: postgres:16-alpine → postgres:18-alpine (resolved to 18.6, image built 2026-10-21, on 2026-10-25)
changes.docker_compose_db_volume: postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data → postgres:/var/lib/postgresql. The 18+ official image defaults PGDATA to /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker and its entrypoint exits with 'Error: in 18+, these Docker images are configured to store database data in a format which is compatible with pg_ctlcluster' whenever anything — even an empty volume — is mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data (docker-library/postgres#1259). Mounting the volume one level up is upstream's recommended layout and keeps a future `pg_upgrade --link` inside one mount
changes.docker_compose_dev_db_client: jbergknoff/postgresql-client:latest → postgres:18-alpine (entrypoint psql unchanged). The old image is amd64-only (emulated on arm64 hosts with a platform warning), last built 2020-08-28 and ships psql 12.3 (EOL 2024-11). psql 12.3 still worked against the 18 server (`select version()`, \l, \dt, \d table, \di all fine), so this is a maintenance/platform fix, not a breakage fix. postgres:18-alpine is already pulled for the db service, so ./go db costs no extra download
changes.claude_md: Troubleshooting bullet: a checkout whose compose volume still holds a 16 data directory fails at db start; recovery is `docker compose down --volumes` then `./go init` (or `./go clean`, which also removes images). No ./go subcommand drops only the volume
changes.version_dates_postgresql_json: 16 → 18 line, EOL 2030-11-14, notes on the PGDATA layout change and the client swap; rds section still 16.13 and points at 19b
changes.not_touched: Dockerfiles (libpq-dev stays for a source build of pg), docker-compose.ci.yml, docker-compose.production_http.yml (inherits the db service), .circleci/config.yml, Gemfile/Gemfile.lock, db/schema.rb, specs, core-iac

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
server.client: pg 1.7.0, PG.library_version 180006 (bundled libpq 18.6) — client and server majors match

tests.db_setup: ./go init → bin/setup → rails db:setup on the fresh 18 volume: 7 tables, 11 schema_migrations rows, max version 20180617085519 = db/schema.rb
tests.rspec: 393 examples, 0 failures, 6 pending (pre-existing 'Not yet implemented' helper/view specs); line coverage 92.19% (437 / 474)
tests.smoke_dry_run: rspec spec/smoke --tag smoke --dry-run: 49 examples load, 0 failures
tests.go_db_dev: docker compose run db_client -c 'select version();' -c '\conninfo' against the 18 server: psql (PostgreSQL) 18.6 connects, no version-skew warning
tests.stale_volume_simulation: 16 data dir mounted at /var/lib/postgresql under the 18 image → entrypoint 'Error: in 18+ ... there appears to be PostgreSQL data in: /var/lib/postgresql'; same dir with PGDATA pinned to /var/lib/postgresql/data → 'FATAL: database files are incompatible with server ... initialized by PostgreSQL version 16'. Both are the texts the CLAUDE.md note names

notes.plan_delta: upgrade_path.json called 19a a one-line change; the image's PGDATA/mount-layout change made it two lines in docker-compose.yml plus the client swap
notes.ci: docker-compose.ci.yml reuses the base file's db service, so CI's database moves to 18 with this PR; CI runs on a fresh volume every time so the stale-volume failure cannot occur there
notes.rds_skew: RDS stays on 16.13 until 19b lands; compose at 18 is two majors ahead, which upgrade_path.json wants to avoid for long, so 19b should follow promptly. db/schema.rb is generated from migrations, not dumped, so no schema drift is expected meanwhile
notes.postgresql_19: 19rc1-alpine is on Docker Hub; the compose image can move to 19-alpine after the 2026-11-19 community GA, but only once RDS has 18 (keep compose at most one major ahead)
notes.next: 19b in core-iac: db_engine_version 16.13 → 18.x and parameter group family postgres16 → postgres18, development → staging → production, each with a pre-upgrade snapshot
